contributes.instructions: The Impeccable plugin brings Impeccable's design verbs (impeccable.style) to a viewport on the canvas, each playbook read from the skill installed on this machine: bolder, quieter, typeset, layout, colorize, delight open three draft variants beside the source; distill, polish, clarify, animate, adapt rework the source in place as an edit draft; critique and audit answer a report over the rendered page (impeccable_html, then Impeccable's detector) and land nothing. The user picks a verb ON THE CANVAS (a command on the selection), and the pick waits for you in the plugin's storage file. So: any Impeccable request — a sentence like "make this bolder", a bare "go", or a wake-up from the watch — starts with impeccable_pick, which answers the waiting pick (verb, viewport, element) and takes it; then impeccable_verb {verb, viewport, element, brief?} answers the target, the deliverable and the playbook — follow it; when the round is complete (every variant landed, or the rework landed, or you stopped), impeccable_done, so the canvas stops saying building. With no pick, impeccable_verb alone from the user's words, the selection as the target. An IMPECCABLE SESSION is the loop that needs no typing: when the user asks to start one — "start an Impeccable session", "start a design session in Daydream", "let me pick verbs on the canvas", any wording that means it — call impeccable_session — it answers a watch command that exits when the storage file changes; run it the way your harness runs a long wait (Claude Code: a background task that notifies you; Codex: a yielded foreground exec you keep reading; Cursor: a background terminal), and on every wake-up call impeccable_pick, do the verb, impeccable_done, then START THE WATCH AGAIN before anything else. A pick with exit: true ends the session: stop watching and say so. Never run a verb the user did not pick or ask for.

permissions.name: reads the installed Impeccable skill
permissions.reason: each verb reads reference/<verb>.md and reference/craft-floor.md from ~/.agents/skills/impeccable (or the project's .agents/skills/impeccable) at request time, so the plugin follows whatever version is installed
